❯ Pemberton Mathematics for Cambridge IGCSE® Extended third edition ❯ Powerpoint presentations - units 1 to 3

  • Secondary Teachers
      • Pemberton Mathematics IGCSE Third Edition
      • Student book answers
      • Powerpoint presentations Units 1-3
      • Powerpoint presentations Units 4-6
      • Powerpoint presentations Units 7-10

Powerpoint presentations - units 1 to 3

These presentations offer extra support for selected topics in the student book.

Unit 1

  • Simplifying algebraic expressions (ppt)
  • Solving linear equations (ppt)
  • Constructing formulae (ppt)
  • Substitution into formulae (ppt)
  • Gradients and straight line graphs (ppt)
  • Order of operations (ppt)
  • Directed numbers (ppt)
  • Multiples, factors, primes, squares and cubes (ppt)
  • Four rules for fractions (ppt)
  • Significant figures and decimal places (ppt)
  • Averages and range (ppt)
  • Frequency tables (ppt)
  • Angle properties (ppt)
  • Symmetry (ppt)
  • Polygons (ppt)

Unit 2

  • Indices 1 (ppt)
  • Solving linear inequalities (ppt)
  • Manipulating algebraic fractions (ppt)
  • The general equation of a straight line (ppt)
  • Representing linear inequalities on graphs (ppt)
  • Percentages 1 (ppt)
  • Ratio (ppt)
  • Displaying data (ppt)
  • Permeter and area (ppt)
  • Pythagoras (ppt)
  • Geometrical constructions (ppt)
  • Loci (ppt)
  • Area and circumference of a circle (ppt)

Unit 3

  • Simultaneous equations 1 (ppt)
  • Factorising 1 (ppt)
  • Rearranging formulae 1 (ppt)
  • Standard form (ppt)
  • Probability 1 (ppt)
  • Similar triangles (ppt)
  • Reflections, rotations and translations (ppt)
  • Enlargements (ppt)
  • Surface area and volume 1 (ppt)
